backbone.architecture: TerraFM-B (ViT-B/16, 12 blocks, 768-d) with an added 14-channel early-fusion patch embedding (Sentinel-1 VV/VH + Sentinel-2 12 bands)
backbone.initialisation: TerraFM-B public weights (Danish et al., 2025; https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/TerraFM, MIT)

fine_tuning.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 0.05, cosine schedule, 5 warm-up epochs
fine_tuning.selected: best validation macro AP: 9th of 10 epochs (stored epoch index 8)
fine_tuning.code: training/backbone/train.py with training/backbone/finetune_terrafm_early_fusion.yaml (provided as used; not re-run)

landuse_head.architecture: one linear 768 -> 4 token classifier on frozen block-11 tokens, with stored input mean/std
landuse_head.training_data: Brazil benchmark main dataset, training split: 448 chips, 81,713 tokens labelled from TerraClass 2024 (token kept when one class covers >= 80%)
landuse_head.validation: 136 chips, 24,544 tokens; epoch selected by validation loss
landuse_head.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-3, weight decay 0.01, 4096-token batches, square-root inverse-frequency class weights, seed 20261001

operating_points: heads/operating_points.json, from the benchmark validation split
